copy.heading: The Home Front
copy.subheading: The house, the children, the car and the group chat.
body: This phase looks at padel's effect on family life. We will cover bath time, the group chat, the car boot and what your children now believe you do for a living. Lauren has contributed most of the material, and asked for a credit on the cover.

illustration.concept: Josh kneeling by a bath full of bubbles and plastic toys, holding a racket instead of a towel and demonstrating a swing to Mia and Alfie, who sit in the water looking unimpressed, while Lauren leans in the bathroom doorway with a towel over her shoulder.
